title: Painters Pallette
description: Clone and change the texture colour of blocks.
body:
Clone a block, change the texture colour just how you like it. IN REAL TIME

If you have bugs or ideas idk join my dc channel [very high quality.]

Right click a block with the tool to open the gui, adjust all the different colours and save it, bam you have the new Recolourded block.
Should work with all blocks from all mods, the block uses it functionality though most of the time.
